set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- One command builds and checks the exact clean tarball.
- Gate includes all dependencies, vignettes, docs consistency, compiled checks, tests, and numerical fixtures.
- Critical skips fail unless reviewed.
- Local, hosted, and publication evidence remain separate.
- Machine output records errors/warnings/notes/skips, version, commit, and artifact digest.
set.title: Create the package release-quality gate
